title: Claim Payment Limits and Covered Items Schedule
content:
This schedule sets the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision) per-loss limits, the items the coverage does and does not pay, and the payment terms. Amounts are in US dollars.

| Package | Towing from the scene, most paid per loss (USD) | Custom parts and equipment, most paid per loss (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $2,500 Deductible | 150 | 1000 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $2,000 Deductible | 150 | 1000 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,500 Deductible | 200 | 1500 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,000 Deductible | 200 | 1500 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $500 Deductible | 250 | 2000 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $250 Comprehensive / $500 Collision Deductible | 250 | 2500 |

The towing limit is the most paid for towing a covered disabled vehicle from the loss scene to a repair facility or storage yard.

### Terms identical in all six packages

| Term | Setting |
|---|---|
| Storage paid through (calendar days after the company notifies the insured to release the vehicle) | 3 days |
| Personal property in the vehicle | Not covered |
| Diminished value | Not paid |
| Payment issued within (calendar days after the amount of a covered loss is agreed) | 10 days |
| Additional damage found during repair (supplements) | Supplemental estimate recorded and paid as a further repair payment |
| Payee of a repair payment | The repair facility when the insured assigns payment; otherwise the named insured and the loss payee jointly |

### Hypothetical reading

- A tow invoice of 230.00 USD on the Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,500 Deductible package is paid up to the 200 USD towing limit. On the Cardinal Point Physical Damage $500 Deductible package the full 230.00 USD is within the 250 USD limit.
- If the release notice is given on a given day, storage is paid through the third calendar day after it.
